Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Add time-based dynamic probability adjustment for vouchers

When a session is running low on time but hasn''t awarded enough
vouchers, the system now automatically increases voucher probability:

- 60% of session time: 2x probability boost per voucher needed
- 80% of session time: 5x probability boost \(urgent\)
- 90% of session time: Force voucher on next spin

This ensures voucher targets are met even with low attendance.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
